# `dialogue` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "dialogue" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/dialogue/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Id of the dialogue; stable forever (saves track visited nodes). |
| `notes` | string | — | What the conversation is for, for writers. |
| `speakers` | list of object | required | Who speaks, besides "player" and "narrator". |
| `speakers[].id` | id | required | Local id lines name in `speaker`. "player" and "narrator" are built in. |
| `speakers[].npc` | ref → creature | — | Id of the NPC creature who speaks. |
| `speakers[].name` | string | — | Display name when there is no `npc` (a voice, a sign). |
| `entries` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Ways in, tried in order; the first whose condition holds starts. The last has none. |
| `entries[].id` | id | required | Id of the entry, for tools and previews. |
| `entries[].when` | object | — | Condition (logic DSL) that must hold. Omit: always. |
| `entries[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `entries[].node` | id | required | Node the conversation starts at. |
| `nodes` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Every step of the conversation. |
| `nodes[].id` | id | required | Id of the node, unique in the dialogue. |
| `nodes[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"line"` | required | Someone speaks. |
| `nodes[].speaker` | id | required | A declared speaker, "player" or "narrator". |
| `nodes[].text` | string | required | What is said, British-leaning (story bible §11.1). |
| `nodes[].textKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `dialogue.<dialogue id>.<node id>` (options add `.<option id>`). |
| `nodes[].next` | id | — | Node that follows. Give `next` or `end: true`. |
| `nodes[].end` | `true` | — | `true`: the conversation ends here. Give `next` or `end: true`. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"choice"` | required | The player picks an option. |
| `nodes[].options` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The options, in display order. |
| `nodes[].options[].id` | id | required | Id of the option, unique in the dialogue; tracked for `once`. |
| `nodes[].options[].text` | string | required | What the player says or does. |
| `nodes[].options[].textKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `dialogue.<dialogue id>.<node id>` (options add `.<option id>`). |
| `nodes[].options[].when` | object | — | Condition (logic DSL) that must hold. Omit: always. |
| `nodes[].options[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].options[].showWhenLocked` | boolean | `false` | When the condition fails: show the option locked with its reason, not hidden. |
| `nodes[].options[].once` | boolean | `false` | Offered only until it has been chosen. |
| `nodes[].options[].effects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Effects (logic DSL) applied together: all or nothing. |
| `nodes[].options[].effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].options[].next` | id | — | Node that follows. Give `next` or `end: true`. |
| `nodes[].options[].end` | `true` | — | `true`: the conversation ends here. Give `next` or `end: true`. |
| `nodes[].options[].onFail` | id | — | Node entered when the effects cannot all apply. Omit: stay and report an error. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"branch"` | required | Routes by condition without showing anything. |
| `nodes[].routes` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Tried in order; the first whose condition holds. |
| `nodes[].routes[].when` | object | required | Condition (logic DSL) for this route. |
| `nodes[].routes[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].routes[].next` | id | required | Id of a node of this dialogue. |
| `nodes[].else` | id | required | Node taken when no route matches. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"check"` | required | A deterministic persuasion check (mw-e22.7). |
| `nodes[].approach` | `"persuade"` \| `"intimidate"` \| `"deceive"` \| `"charm"` | required | How the player tries. |
| `nodes[].difficulty` | integer ≥ 1 | required | Score needed; the player’s score is computed from data. |
| `nodes[].target` | id | — | Speaker being worked on (its NPC’s disposition and personality count). Default: the NPC being talked to. |
| `nodes[].modifiers` | list of object | `[]` | Extra score from items, facts, class. |
| `nodes[].modifiers[].when` | object | required | Condition (logic DSL) under which the modifier applies. |
| `nodes[].modifiers[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].modifiers[].bonus` | integer | required | Added to the score. |
| `nodes[].modifiers[].label` | string | required | Why, in the words shown to the player ("You look the part"). |
| `nodes[].success` | id | required | Node entered when the score meets the difficulty. |
| `nodes[].failure` | id | required | Node entered otherwise: failures must continue the story. |
| `nodes[].successEffects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Effects (logic DSL) applied together: all or nothing. |
| `nodes[].successEffects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].failureEffects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Effects (logic DSL) applied together: all or nothing. |
| `nodes[].failureEffects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"effect"` | required | Changes the world, silently. |
| `nodes[].effects` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Effects (logic DSL) applied together: all or nothing. |
| `nodes[].effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `nodes[].onFail` | id | — | Node entered when the effects cannot all apply. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"jump"` | required | Continues in another dialogue. |
| `nodes[].dialogue` | ref → dialogue | required | Id of the dialogue to continue in. |
| `nodes[].node` | id | — | Node of that dialogue. Omit: its entries decide. |
| `nodes[].kind` | `"end"` | required | The conversation ends. |
